prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、规格与评价，找到适合自己的型号。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向比较同一行的价格、屏幕、续航、重量和评价；也会纵向扫描同一指标。行高应由较长的评价自然决定，其他单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["型号是每行的识别入口；价格是独立的购买指标。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可纵向比较的规格，宽度应支持数字与单位的辨认。","评价是描述性文字，与前面的短规格不同，需要更多换行空间。"],"keep_intact":["价格及其货币符号和数字","型号中的 X1、Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、分辨类型以及重量数值和单位应尽量保持易读"],"may_wrap":["型号名称可在系列名与后缀之间换行","屏幕尺寸与面板类型可分行","续航的约数和天数可在自然位置换行","评价可按中文语义自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [59, 71, 60, 51, 51, 67] · table 360×857px · row heights [60, 246, 246, 106, 199] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [51, 71, 60, 51, 51, 75] · table 360×857px · row heights [60, 246, 246, 106, 199] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [51, 71, 65, 51, 60, 61] · table 360×1275px · row heights [60, 385, 362, 176, 292] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 16 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"价格完整，型号中的系列名和后缀基本保持可辨；屏幕和评价标题也保持单行。评价决定行高，四行之间的分隔清楚。","problems":"续航和重量标题竖排式换行；重量数字与 g 分离，续航数值也被拆成多行。评价每行字数很少，阅读节奏零碎，规格列下方留下大片空白。","cause":"续航和重量各 51px，扣除内边距后只有 30px，刚好不足以容纳实际标题和部分数值组合；评价 67px 仅留 46px 给正文。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"价格仍完整，评价比 r1A 略宽；屏幕规格的换行方式与 r1A 相近。","problems":"型号标题换成两行，系列名也被拆成单字，识别入口变弱；续航和重量仍然破碎。虽然评价稍宽，整体行高并未改善。","cause":"型号从 59px 缩至 51px，正文可用宽度仅 30px；评价增加到 75px 后，实际换行仍落在相同的行数区间。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"重量数值与单位保持在同一行，便于纵向比较；屏幕列更宽。","problems":"评价变成很窄的字串，语句难以连续阅读，行高大幅增加，规格列出现更大片空白；型号和续航标题仍换行，型号系列名被拆开。","cause":"重量增至 60px、屏幕增至 65px，挤占了评价列，使其仅有 61px、正文可用宽度仅 40px；型号仍只有 51px，续航只有 51px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"评价优先","widths":[56,71,55,46,47,84],"change":"保留完整价格和较清楚的型号入口，将屏幕、续航和重量压窄以把评价增至 84px。测试更多评价宽度能否减少行数并改善整表节奏；代价是短规格和部分标题可能进一步换行。"},{"name":"均衡微调","widths":[56,71,60,51,51,70],"change":"以 r1A 为基础，从型号列挪出 3px 给评价，保留价格和规格列宽度。测试型号仍能否保持系列名完整，以及评价是否跨过有意义的换行阈值。"},{"name":"重量与评价折中","widths":[59,71,55,46,51,77],"change":"保留 r1A 的型号、价格和重量宽度，从屏幕与续航各让出 5px，将评价增至 77px。测试更宽的评价能否改善行高，同时维持型号识别。"}]}
